sources.title: FDA Code of Federal Regulations Title 21 Part 820.198
sources.cite: A regulatory requirement outlining the procedures for handling complaints concerning medical devices, emphasizing the importance of documentation, investigation, and corrective action.

sources.title: FDA Code of Federal Regulations Title 21 Part 211.198
sources.cite: Pharma companies must have documented SOPs for handling complaints, timely complaint review, investigation requirements if a complaint indicates possible failure of the drug to meet specifications, batch record examination for every quality-related complaint, and complaint records must be maintained for at least 1 year after the product's expiration date.
